<!-- EXPERIMENTAL "rail" layout (draft). Same DGF and the same blocks as
     research-guide.qmd, rearranged after the econometrics course site:
     a left rail per variable and a numbered two-column contents list.
     Layout code: rg-rail.R   Styles: rg-rail.css
     Render:  quarto::quarto_render("research-guide-rail.qmd") -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library( datagoodr )
source( "rg-rail.R" )

dgf <- load_dgf( params$dgf_file, reader = "readxl" )

rtype  <- dg_render_type( dgf )
groups <- list(
  Boolean     = dgf[ rtype == "boolean",     ],
  Categorical = dgf[ rtype == "categorical", ],
  Numeric     = dgf[ rtype == "number",      ],
  Text        = dgf[ rtype == "text",        ],
  Identifier  = dgf[ rtype == "identifier",  ],
  Temporal    = dgf[ rtype == "temporal",    ] )
```

```{r style, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
cat( "<style>\n", paste( readLines( "rg-rail.css", warn = FALSE ), collapse = "\n" ), "\n</style>\n" )
```

```{r contents, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
rail_toc( groups )
```

```{r boolean, echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=2.6}
rail_group( groups$Boolean, "Boolean" )
```

```{r categorical, echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
rail_group( groups$Categorical, "Categorical" )
```

```{r numeric, echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=2}
rail_group( groups$Numeric, "Numeric" )
```

```{r text, echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
rail_group( groups$Text, "Text" )
```

```{r identifier, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
rail_group( groups$Identifier, "Identifier" )
```

```{r temporal, echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
rail_group( groups$Temporal, "Temporal" )
```
